cc:Work.dc:title: Set 1: inverse and exponential LDR models
cc:Work.dc:description: All thirteen readings with horizontal angular uncertainty of ±2 degrees. Green points use beta = 0.47 per kiloohm; red points use the inverse-resistance model. The blue line is ideal Malus law.
